description: Typed Go SDK for the OKX v5 exchange API: REST, typed WebSocket channels with automatic reconnects, WebSocket trading, a local order book, safe retries and a per-endpoint rate limiter. Module github.com/kennnyz/okx-golang, package okx.
rules: Import the module as okx "github.com/kennnyz/okx-golang"; the package name is okx.
Use okx.NewClient for REST and okx.NewStream for WebSocket; both take the same options.
Keep prices and sizes as strings or okx.Number; never convert money to float64.
Generate ClOrdID with okx.NewClientOrderID() before placing an order, and look the order up by ClOrdID after a timeout instead of sending it again.
Develop and test against demo trading with okx.WithDemoTrading() and a demo API key.
Match errors with errors.Is (okx.ErrInsufficientBalance, okx.ErrRateLimited) or okx.HasCode(err, code); for batch calls check each result's Err().
Use client.Do or stream.Subscribe for endpoints and channels the SDK does not wrap yet.
